_comment: Gen-5 Elysium TESTNET config. Read by script/DeployElysium.s.sol. v4.* are filled in after YOU self-deploy v4-core on testnet (non-production use, permitted by BUSL-1.1 — see runbook). These testnet addresses must NEVER appear in elysium-mainnet.json.

v4._comment: EMPTY until you self-deploy v4-core/periphery on testnet (DeployElysiumV4.s.sol). Fill, then re-run DeployElysium.

params._comment: openingValuationHype is the per-chain opening fully-diluted valuation in HYPE. openingTickWhype is its tick for a 1e9 18-dec supply paired against WHYPE (spacing 60), computed off-chain and asserted spacing-aligned on-chain. protocolFeeBps=2000 (20% protocol / 80% creator-side). swapFee bounds 100..1000 (1%..10%). treasuryEnabled=false (no feeds on Elysium).
params._openingComment: PROPOSED default pending your confirm: 27 HYPE (~$2,268 @ $84/HYPE ≈ the $2,255/1-ETH target). Alternatives: 25 HYPE -> tick -175080; 30 HYPE -> tick -173220. openingTickWhype is token-as-currency0; the factory negates it when the token sorts as currency1.

router._comment: FeeRouterV5 construction params, shared across every launch. maxSlippageBps caps the buyback swap's price impact. maxRoutePerCall = "0" means unlimited (script translates to type(uint256).max). routeCooldownSecs throttles permissionless route() calls.

owner._comment: Testnet owner = ely-testnet EOA (--sender). Fill with that address before simulating. Mainnet goes to a Safe; transferOwnership paths are tested.

ballast._comment: Filled after broadcast. These are the gen-5 deployment addresses on testnet.

mocks._comment: TESTNET-ONLY mock stock tokens (clearly marked). NEVER referenced in mainnet config. Used only as swap pairs / allowlist test targets — not as launch quote assets (no feeds to price them).
